name: pm
description: DataCraft PM, the hands-on way of working: outcome-sized tickets, a one-session default loop (whats-next, the work, stepping-away), sibling sessions for independent tickets, opt-in orchestration, proportionate verification, delivery acceptance and concise handoffs. For unattended ticket runs use the factory plugin (Runway); the credential guard moved to the sdlc plugin in 0.24.0.
